content: Managed AI Models are now available in public preview in Azure Logic Apps Automation, enabling developers to bring AI capabilities into workflows and agents without provisioning, deploying, or managing model infrastructure. Building AI-powered automation often requires developers to configure model deployments, manage credentials, and maintain supporting infrastructure before they can begin developing workflows. Managed AI Models simplify this experience by providing ready-to-use AI models directly within Logic Apps Automation. With Managed AI Models, customers can: Accelerate AI-powered automation: Use managed models to add AI capabilities to workflows and agents without configuring or maintaining model deployments. Build intelligent workflows faster: Combine AI-driven reasoning with deterministic workflow actions to automate tasks such as issue triage, content summarization, and operational analysis. Reduce infrastructure complexity: Focus on building business process automation while Logic Apps Automation manages the underlying model infrastructure. Managed AI Models help developers move from ideas to working AI-powered automations faster, while retaining the orchestration and integration capabilities of Azure Logic Apps Automation. Learn more.
